title: kate-lsp: add a fake language server for the tests
summary: The binary fake-lsp-server speaks JSON-RPC over stdio and answers the requests the client tests need: initialize, shutdown, hover, completion, definition, and references, and it publishes one diagnostic after didOpen. Integration tests spawn it through CARGO_BIN_EXE_fake-lsp-server. No network.

lane.reason: A Cursor cloud agent codes this packet. The crate is pure Rust, the test runs a fake server over pipes on Linux, and the backlog marks the LSP client CLOUD.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Use kate_lsp::jsonrpc::{read_message, write_message, parse_message, response_body, notification_body}. The publishDiagnostics after didOpen carries the uri and the version from the params and one diagnostic with severity 2 and message fake. After didChange it publishes an empty list. exit ends the process with code 0. The integration test tests/fake_server.rs spawns env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_fake-lsp-server") with piped stdio, writes an initialize request, reads the response, asserts hoverProvider is true, writes shutdown and exit, and asserts the process exits 0. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: fake_server::initialize_answers_with_capabilities
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because the binary does not exist. After the change the fake server answers initialize over pipes and exits on exit.
